issues.detail: The Greek 'τιτω' (Tito) is the vocative case, meaning 'O Titus'. The Vietnamese translation 'Gửi cho Tít' (Send to Titus / To Titus) changes the grammatical function from a direct address to an indirect recipient.

The Vietnamese adds 'nguyền xin con được' (I pray/beg that I may receive), which is not present in the Greek. The Greek text is a direct blessing/greeting, not a request or prayer for personal reception.
